Phase 9 – Service Integration & Action Automation
Objective

Connect Neon Vision to all key services: Pilot, VSO, CGI Ads, YouTube, Social Media, GEO/SEO, AI Automation.

Enable real-time action triggers, automatic updates, and performance tracking.

Reduce manual work, ensure full automation of workflows, and improve client experience.

1. Service Connections
Service	Integration Type	Key Actions
CGI & Performance Pilot	API / Internal DB	Start pilot, track step completion, push performance metrics, alert users to next step
Voice Search Optimization (VSO)	API / Webhooks	Update keyword rankings, trigger optimization reports, send alerts for Position Zero gains
YouTube Ads	API / Ads Manager	Launch campaigns, monitor ROAS, pause/fix underperforming ads automatically
Social Media Management	API / Social Platforms	Schedule posts, reverse shadowbans, track engagement, push alerts on viral trends
GEO & AI SEO	API / Content DB	Update AI-friendly content, detect plagiarism, generate SERP/zero-cl
